conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 36 years old, and I'm here because I hurt my left ankle a couple of days ago when I slipped on some ice. It's been swollen and really painful, and it's hard for me to walk on it.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please confirm your age, gender, and describe the injury to your left ankle in more detail, including when it occurred and what activity you were doing at the time?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 36 years old, and I'm a female. I hurt my left ankle about two days ago when I was walking to my car and slipped on some snow and ice. It twisted underneath me, and I fell. It's been swollen and really painful since then, and it's hard for me to walk on it.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any previous ankle injuries or conditions, such as sprains, fractures, or arthritis?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't had any previous ankle injuries or conditions like sprains, fractures, or arthritis. This is the first time I've had an issue like this.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe the nature of the pain in your left ankle? Is it sharp, dull, throbbing, or a combination of these? Have you noticed any bruising or deformity around the ankle area?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The pain is more of a throbbing and aching feeling, especially on the outside of my ankle. I haven't noticed any bruising, but there's quite a bit of swelling. It doesn't look deformed, just really sore and swollen.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your left foot or ankle since the injury?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in my left foot or ankle since the injury. It's just sore and swollen, but I can still feel everything normally.
